decision: Which parts of our marketing system are the weak links to fix first for our stage?
limitations: It is a self-assessment against AAJ's own bands, not a benchmark. Nothing in it says how you rank against other companies.
Scores are only as honest as the answers. It flags high scores with no evidence marked, but cannot check the artefacts itself.
Each dimension is an average of three answers, so a 'fully' and a 'not yet' can land as a middling score. The engine flags the split; read the answers, not only the score.
The statements move over quarters, so monthly re-runs mostly show changes in how people answered, not in the function.
review: The founder or marketing lead checks the artefact behind every flagged high score (positioning statement, ICP, CAC by channel, NRR and GRR) and re-scores any that are missing before the weak links set the plan.
